title: 町で働く人 フラット
subject_en: Community workers each shown as ONE friendly person at work with a typical prop, simple flat style, varied ages and skin tones, 4.5-head proportion, simple dot eyes. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters.
lead: 駅員・配達員・消防士・図書館員など、町で働く人をフラットなタッチで描いた12点です。地域のお知らせや学習資料に使えます。
items: a station attendant in uniform and cap with a signal paddle
a mail carrier with a bag on a scooter
a greengrocer with an apron beside a crate of vegetables
a firefighter in a helmet holding a hose
a librarian with a cart of books
a baker holding a tray of bread
a bus driver at the wheel, smiling
a sanitation worker with a broom and a cart
a farmer with a straw hat holding a radish
a teacher pointing at a blank blackboard
